name: Covert Cups | 200mg Rosin Chocolate Treats | Strawberry Fields
description:
Take a bite out of the ordinary with our HASH ROSIN CUPS! Delicious and discrete, our HASH ROSIN Cups are a great way to get high on the low. Each package comes with 8 MINI Cups totaling 200mg THC.

Packing 25mg THC into each cup, this tasty treat is the perfect pick-me up, specially packaged to microdose your experience.

Bite into a sea of strawberry jam overflowing with flavor coated in gourmet milk chocolate. 25mg per cup packing a potent punch in a delicious mini treat.

Covert Cups hash rosin chocolate edible cups are cannabis-infused chocolates known for our high potency, amazing taste and exceptional quality.
